description: Server-side security: five exposed secrets are embedded across server/app.py (2), config/seeds.json (2) and the token table of db/seed.sqlite (1) in the local TokenGate gateway. Rotate all five with fresh values while keeping the app bootable, retire every old value from the tree, and write sha256-prefix digest lines per location; the provided offline suite scans the tree, imports the app and checks the report digests.

criteria: All five secrets were rotated with fresh distinct values in server/app.py, config/seeds.json and db/seed.sqlite, the retired values are absent from the whole tree, and the app still boots.
python3 tests/rotation_test.py passes, report/rotation.txt carries the five location lines with correct 12-hex sha256 prefixes of the new values, and the test suite and README are untouched.
